cut.excludes: the stars of stars.json, one-to-one: by HIP; else by epoch-2016 position and V (< 3" and |dV| < 3; < 30", |dV| < 1.5, distance within 15 %; < 120", |dV| < 1.5, distance within 10 % and proper motion within 10 %); plus any further source < 3" (|dV| < 3) from a stars.json star (a close companion already in its V)
